question: In which of the following years did India start celebrating National Sports Day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2012**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points __

 
• The National Sports Day in India is celebrated on August 29.
 
• National Sports Day was included in the list of celebratory days in India for the first time in 2012.
 
• The National Sports Day is celebrated to commemorate the birth anniversary of hockey legend Dhyan Chand Singh.
 
• The government has also used this day as a platform to launch various sports schemes, including the Khelo India movement, which was announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2018.
 
• The National Sports Day is also an occasion that sees the nation honour its sporting heroes with recognitions like the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna, Arjuna Award, Dhyan Chand Award and the Dronacharya Award.
 
• At a special ceremony held at the Rashtrapati Bhavan, the President of India takes this day to confer these awards.
